title: cli i18n-coverage: the hook bucket is labelled "hook refusals" but now also counts missing hook texts
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: contract review N3 on PR #34545 (Part of #34374, review 6939428411), passed on by area `o2-D`. Dedupe: `i18n-coverage hook refusals`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p3 · domain:server · Blocked-by #34374 (the hook-text bucket exists only after PR #34545 merges)

## 维护者速读

- 现象:`os` 的翻译覆盖报告把钩子这一桶叫「hook refusals」(钩子拒绝语)。#34545 之后，钩子声明的给人读的句子(`texts`)缺译文也计在这一桶里，报告仍按「拒绝语」报，读报告的人会以为缺的是拒绝语。
- 为什么要修：报告的名字和内容对不上，翻译人员会找错地方。
- 需要你做的：无(分诊定级)。

## Change

In `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts`, name the `hook` bucket for what it now counts (refusals and texts), or split it into two buckets. Pin the report line for a hook with one missing refusal and one missing text.

## Done when

The coverage report names a missing hook text as a hook text.
